title: Greet the Sun
line: In the morning, for energy, clarity and purpose.
intro: Surya, the Sun, is the visible source of life and light. Greeting the sun in the morning is one of the oldest practices there is. Do this facing the morning light if you can.
offering: Water poured towards the sun, a moment of gratitude for light.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Stand or sit facing the morning light if you can. Breathe in as the circle grows, out as it settles.

steps.title: The Gayatri
steps.text: The most revered Vedic prayer, to the light of Savitr: may that light guide our understanding.

steps.title: Your purpose today
steps.prompt: What do I want to give my energy to today?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Sundays, and sunrise on any day.
